close_reason: landed 3bf00d70f; zero-field struct references now record real requester spans; verified cargo test --lib, clippy -D warnings, zero_field_struct and struct diagnostic tests
description:
SURFACED by the fz-rh2.17.5.6.11 audit; both are PRE-EXISTING/latent, shared across the .10 (resolve) and .11 (body.rs lowering) obligation walks -- NOT introduced or worsened by either slice. Two small span/coverage gaps in the struct obligation model:

1. BARE %A{} (ZERO FIELDS) -> DUMMY SPAN: record_struct_reference (jobs/body.rs ~630) and collect_struct_field_obligations (source_publish.rs) only call note_struct_field_expectation PER NAMED FIELD. A bare %A{} with no fields still records the StructDefined wait but ZERO expectation entries, so when A is a non-struct module, unresolved_struct_issue's span lookup (world.rs ~2892: struct_expectations.expectations(module).first()) falls back to Span::DUMMY -- the RESOLVE_NOT_A_STRUCT diagnostic still FIRES (not a stall) but points nowhere useful for a fieldless struct reference. FIX: record a struct-MODULE reference (with the %A{} usage span) even when there are zero field obligations, so the diagnostic has a real requester span. Applies to both resolve and lowering walks (fold-concordant, do both).

2. UNQUOTE WALK ASYMMETRY (dead-safe today): collect_unquote_dispatch_requirements' Expr::Struct arm (jobs/body.rs) recurses field values but does NOT call record_struct_reference, unlike the live-code walk. Currently harmless because QuoteLowerer's Expr::Struct errors with 'compiler2 quote does not lower Struct yet' (LOWER_UNSUPPORTED) -- no %A{} inside quote do..end reaches lower_struct_expr/pattern. WIRE record_struct_reference into the unquote walk WHEN quote gains struct support (track alongside that feature). Related: fz-rh2.17.5.6.10, fz-rh2.17.5.6.11, fz-b6w (obligation model).
title: Struct obligation diagnostics point at Span::DUMMY for a bare %A{} (zero-field) reference; unquote walk doesn't record struct refs
